# Gradle wrapper

[gradle-wrapper.properties](gradle-wrapper.properties) pins the Gradle distribution; [gradle-wrapper.jar](gradle-wrapper.jar) is the launcher used by the parent `gradlew` scripts.

Review distribution-version or wrapper changes alongside the Expo/React Native Android build requirements. Do not place downloaded distributions or caches in this folder. Start native builds through the [app workflow](../../../README.md) so its checks run first.
